items.prompt: After popping a head from stream B, which stream should replenish that heap entry?

options.text: StreamB, because its next unseen value is the new head
options.why: Other streams already retain their own current heads.

options.text: Every stream simultaneously, discarding the previous heads
An arbitrary stream chosen by its length
options.why: Length does not identify the next unseen value for the popped stream.

options.text: None, even if stream Bhas remaining data
options.why: That would drop the rest of that stream.

items.explanation: One head per active stream is the invariant. Replenish exactly the stream whose head was emitted.
